scope: Training-only dataset facts and mechanism conditions for long_view research planning.

dataset_facts.evaluation_structure: within-user ranking; Primary is mean(validation GAUC, validation nDCG@5)
dataset_facts.inference_constraint: play_time, click, like, follow and comment are post-exposure outcomes; use them only as training supervision, never prediction-time features

bpr.use_when: users contain both positive and negative training examples and evaluation is within-user ranking
bpr.failure_check: compare paired seeds and avoid assuming more negatives or hard negatives help

censored_watchtime.use_when: training has play_time and duration but completed plays are right-censored by video length
censored_watchtime.mechanism: incomplete plays use exact log-watch regression; completed plays use a one-sided lower-bound loss at log(duration)
censored_watchtime.distinction: this is not capped log-watch MSE and not completion-ratio BCE

target_statistics.use_when: statistics are computed from strict past/train-only data with leave-one-out for training rows
target_statistics.failure_check: run rolling validation and matched structural controls for appended categorical fields

ensemble.use_when: component predictions have measured conditional error complementarity
ensemble.failure_check: high standalone score or low global correlation alone is insufficient

hard_negative_sampling.use_when: the negative score used for mining is sufficiently calibrated and does not collapse diversity
hard_negative_sampling.project_evidence: the current semi-hard pools reduced validation Primary; do not repeat without a materially different sampler

global_context.project_evidence: scientifically uncertain but submission-eligible: official +0.000431, rolling 3/3 mean +0.000810, paired seeds 3/4 mean +0.000333 with interval crossing zero
